headline: Revenue rebounds but losses widen and leverage climbs
summary_short: FMC's Q2 2026 revenue was $867.1M, up 14.3% q/q but down 17.5% y/y, while the operating loss widened to $119.7M (from $81M q/q, +$126.4M profit y/y) and diluted EPS was -$1.49 versus -$2.25 q/q and $0.53 y/y.
summary_long: Revenue was $867.1M (+14.3% q/q, -17.5% y/y). Gross margin was 39.5%, up from 32.5% q/q and roughly flat y/y (38.7%). Operating loss widened to $119.7M (vs -$81M q/q, +$126.4M y/y); EBITDA fell to -$81.9M. Diluted EPS was -$1.49 (vs -$2.25 q/q, $0.53 y/y). Cash rose to $476.6M (+21.9% q/q). Long-term debt grew to $3.96B (+17.9% q/q) while short-term debt fell to $9.3M from $590.1M; equity fell to $1.64B from $4.40B y/y.
